title: Android 9.0 Notification Issue
body: The apps notification doesn't support 9.0 dark/night mode and is stuck being white.

comments.body: I'd love to see an option to customize the notification background (make it dark) as well.
Are you talking about the persistent notification with the graph?
Yes, on 8.0/8.1 the background of the notification would change color but since updating to 9.0 it just stays permanently white.
I would like to know that too. Loving the night mode on my note 8 but xDrip persistent notification is white. 😔

So finally I manage to make it use dark mode. It was completely random. I changed device font and then switched it back to default font. One problem is that after restart it comes back as white and I have to do all process again. Could this bee a problem with fonts or this is one of Samsung "optimizations"? Using Note 8 with OneUI.
